fields.title: Custom fields
fields.hint: Extra details you keep about your records, such as a vehicle plate or a hair type. They appear on the record's screen for the people who may edit it.
fields.loadFailed: The custom fields could not be loaded.
fields.noRecords: No records can have custom fields yet
fields.noRecordsHint: Switch on a module with records you want to add details to, then come back.
fields.label: Name
fields.labelHint: What people see, for example Vehicle plate.
fields.keyHint: Letters, digits and _ only. It cannot be changed later.
fields.kindFixed: The kind cannot be changed once the field is made.
fields.requiredHint: A record cannot be saved without it.
fields.searchableHint: Lets you find records by this text.
fields.deleteAsk: {{name}} and everything entered in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone. To keep the details and only stop asking for them, hide the field instead.
